items.source: Note that the given data buffers do not have to be released, as they are released as part of the returned composite.
items.translation: 注意，给定的数据缓冲区不需要释放，因为它们会作为返回的复合对象的一部分被释放。

items.source: Wrap the given ByteBuffer in a DataBuffer. Unlike allocating, wrapping does not use new memory.
items.translation: 将给定的ByteBuffer包装在DataBuffer中。与分配不同，包装不会使用新的内存。

items.source: Wrap the given byte array in a DataBuffer. Unlike allocating, wrapping does not use new memory.
items.translation: 将给定的byte数组包装在DataBuffer中。与分配不同，包装不会使用新的内存。

items.source:
Allocate a data buffer of a default initial capacity. Depending on the
underlying implementation and its configuration, this will be heap-based
or direct buffer.
items.translation: 分配一个默认初始容量的数据缓冲区。根据底层实现及其配置，这将是基于堆的或直接的缓冲区。

items.source:

underlying implementation and its configuration, this will be heap-based
or direct buffer.

items.source:
Indicates whether this factory allocates direct buffers (i.e. non-heap,
native memory).
